7062-a-daughter-of-fife.title: A Daughter Of Fife
7062-a-daughter-of-fife.creator: Amelia E. Barr
7062-a-daughter-of-fife.description: A book by Amelia E. Barr. The weakest of their women have felt the hallowing touch of sudden calamity, and of long, lonely, life-and-death, watches. They are intensely religious, they hold tenaciously to the modes of thought and speech, to the manner of living and dressing, and to all the household traditions which they have cherished for centuries.

arxiv-1811-02279.title: J-PLUS: Identification of low-metallicity stars with artificial neural networks using SPHINX
arxiv-1811-02279.creator: D. D. Whitten ,, V. M. Placco ,, T. C. Beers ,, A. L. Chies-Santos, C. Bonatto, J. Varela, D. Cristóbal-Hornillos, A. Ederoclite, T. Masseron, Y. S. Lee, S. Akras, M. Borges Fernandes, J. A. Caballero, A. J. Cenarro, P. Coelho, M. V. Costa-Duarte, S. Daflon, R. A. Dupke, R. Lopes de Oliveira, C. Lóp
arxiv-1811-02279.description: Abstract Context. We present a new methodology for the estimation of stellar atmospheric parameters from narrow- and intermediate-band photometry of the Javalambre Photometric Local Universe Survey (J-PLUS), and propose a method for target pre-selection of low-metallicity stars for follow-up spectroscopic studies. Photometric metallicity estimates for stars in the globular cluster M15 are determined using this method. Aims.

arxiv-2104-11215.title: On the fixed-parameter tractability of the partial vertex cover problem with a matching constraint in edge-weighted bipartite graphs Journal: Sample Journal
arxiv-2104-11215.creator: Vahan Mkrtchyan, Garik Petrosyan
arxiv-2104-11215.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Vahan Mkrtchyan, Garik Petrosyan. In the classical partial vertex cover problem, we are given a graph G G and two positive integers R R and L L . The goal is to check whether there is a subset V ′ V^{\prime} of V V of size at most R R , such that V ′ V^{\prime} covers at least L L edges of G G . The problem is NP-hard as it includes the Vertex Cover problem.

arxiv-2302-04763.title: On Sampling with Approximate Transport Maps
arxiv-2302-04763.creator: Louis Grenioux, Alain Oliviero Durmus, Éric Moulines, Marylou Gabrié
arxiv-2302-04763.description: Abstract Transport maps can ease the sampling of distributions with non-trivial geometries by transforming them into distributions that are easier to handle. The potential of this approach has risen with the development of Normalizing Flows (NF) which are maps parameterized with deep neural networks trained to push a reference distribution towards a target.

arxiv-2303-17843.title: Tambara-Yamagami Categories over the Reals: The Non-Split Case
arxiv-2303-17843.creator: Julia Plavnik, Sean Sanford, Dalton Sconce
arxiv-2303-17843.description: Abstract . Tambara and Yamagami investigated a simple set of fusion rules with only one non-invertible object, and proved under which circumstances those rules could be given a coherent associator. They also classified all of the resulting fusion categories up to monoidal equivalence.

arxiv-2311-18520.title: Calibration-free online test-time adaptation for electroencephalography motor imagery decoding
arxiv-2311-18520.creator: 1 st Martin Wimpff, 2 nd Mario Döbler, 3 rd Bin Yang
arxiv-2311-18520.description: Abstract Providing a promising pathway to link the human brain with external devices, Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs) have seen notable advancements in decoding capabilities, primarily driven by increasingly sophisticated techniques, especially deep learning. However, achieving high accuracy in real-world scenarios remains a challenge due to the distribution shift between sessions and subjects.

arxiv-2404-16071.creator: Joseph Tu, Hilda Hadan, Derrick M. Wang, Sabrina A. Sgandurra, Reza Hadi Mogavi, Lennart E. Nacke
arxiv-2404-16071.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Joseph Tu, Hilda Hadan, Derrick M. Wang, Sabrina A. Sgandurra, Reza Hadi Mogavi, Lennart E. Nacke. This workshop paper presents a critical examination of the integration of Generative AI (Gen AI) into the academic writing process, focusing on the use of AI as a collaborative tool. It contrasts the performance and interaction of two AI models, Gemini and ChatGPT, through a collaborative inquiry approach where researchers engage in facilitated sessions to design prompts that elicit specific AI responses for crafting research outlines.

arxiv-2409-09153.title: Winding Topology of Multifold Exceptional Points
arxiv-2409-09153.creator: Tsuneya Yoshida, J. Lukas K. König, Lukas Rødland, Emil J. Bergholtz, Marcus Stålhammar
arxiv-2409-09153.description: Abstract Despite their ubiquity, a systematic classification of multifold exceptional points, n n -fold spectral degeneracies (EP n n s), remains a significant unsolved problem. In this article, we characterize the Abelian eigenvalue topology of generic EP n n s and symmetry-protected EP n n s for arbitrary n n .

arxiv-2511-02716.title: Nonadiabatic corrections to electric quadrupole transition rates in H 2
arxiv-2511-02716.creator: Krzysztof Pachucki a and Michał Siłkowski b
arxiv-2511-02716.description: Abstract We derive formulas and perform calculations of nonadiabatic corrections to rates of electric quadrupole transitions in the hydrogen molecule. These corrections can be represented in terms of a single curve D ( 1 ) ​ ( R ) D^{(1)}(R) , similarly to the Born-Oppenheimer one, D ( 0 ) ​ ( R ) D^{(0)}(R) , derived originally by Wolniewicz.

arxiv-2512-13689.title: LitePT: Lighter Yet Stronger Point Transformer
arxiv-2512-13689.creator: Yuanwen Yue, Damien Robert, Jianyuan Wang, Sunghwan Hong, Jan Dirk Wegner, Christian Rupprecht, Konrad Schindler
arxiv-2512-13689.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuanwen Yue, Damien Robert, Jianyuan Wang, Sunghwan Hong, Jan Dirk Wegner, Christian Rupprecht, Konrad Schindler. Modern neural architectures for 3D point cloud processing contain both convolutional layers and attention blocks, but the best way to assemble them remains unclear.

pmc-10616738.title: Diurnal and geographic variations of pollinator importance for Cucurbita maxima Duchesne
pmc-10616738.creator: Mito Ikemoto, Yoshihiro Tanaka, Katsuyuki Kohno, Tomoyuki Yokoi
pmc-10616738.description: Despite growing awareness of the importance of monitoring wild crop pollinators worldwide, there are still few reports, especially in East Asia. Considering ongoing global warming may change the distribution range and diurnal activity of pollinators, it is necessary to describe current geographic and diurnal patterns.

pmc-11328768.title: Mortality, Cardiovascular Disease, and Their Associations With Risk Factors in Southeast Asia
pmc-11328768.creator: Aditya K. Khetan, Lia M. Palileo-Villanueva, Nafiza Mat-Nasir, Rosnah Ismail, Antonio Miguel Dans, Marc Evans M. Abat, Shofiqul Islam, Philip Joseph, Darryl P. Leong, Koon K. Teo, Sumathy Rangarajan, Salim Yusuf
pmc-11328768.description: BackgroundThe drivers of cardiovascular disease (CVD) and all-cause mortality may differ around the world. Regional-level prospective data can help guide policies to reduce CVD and all-cause mortality.ObjectivesThis study examined the incidence of CVD and mortality in Malaysia and the Philippines and estimated the population-level risks attributable to common risk factors for each outcome.

pmc-12418695.title: Use of artificial intelligence for classification of fractures around the elbow in adults according to the 2018 AO/OTA classification system
pmc-12418695.creator: Annelie Pettersson, Michael Axenhus, Teo Stukan, Oscar Ljungberg, Hans Nåsell, Ali Sharif Razavian, Max Gordon
pmc-12418695.description: BackgroundThis study evaluates the accuracy of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) system, specifically a convolutional neural network (CNN), in classifying elbow fractures using the detailed 2018 AO/OTA fracture classification system.MethodsA retrospective analysis of 5,367 radiograph exams visualizing the elbow from adult patients (2002–2016) was conducted using a deep neural network.

pmc-12468483.title: Media Exposure and Vicarious Trauma: Italian Adaptation and Validation of the Media Vicarious Traumatization Scale and Its Impact on Young Adults’ Mental Health in Relation to Contemporary Armed Conflicts
pmc-12468483.creator: Giorgio Maria Regnoli, Gioia Tiano, Barbara De Rosa, Francisco Manuel Morales Rodríguez
pmc-12468483.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). In recent years, psychological research has increasingly focused on the impact of media exposure on mental health, identifying young adults as particularly vulnerable due to their high levels of media engagement. To explore these effects, the construct of Media Vicarious Traumatization (MVT) has been introduced as an extension of vicarious traumatization, aimed at capturing the psychological impact of emotionally intense media content.

pmc-12478172.title: Pseudouridine prevalence in Kaposi’s sarcoma–associated herpesvirus transcriptome reveals an essential mechanism for viral replication
pmc-12478172.creator: Timothy J. Mottram, Katherine L. Harper, Elton J. R. Vasconcelos, Adrian Whitehouse
pmc-12478172.description: SignificanceResurging interest in RNA modifications has been driven by advancements in transcriptome-wide mapping and the identification of RNA modifications in all RNA species. Pseudouridine is an abundant single nucleotide modification found in all functional RNA species, however its role within messenger RNA (mRNA) and non-coding RNA (ncRNA) is largely unknown.

pmc-12546682.title: Morphology-regulated millet bran nanocellulose-zein nanoparticles complexes: stabilization of Pickering emulsions and β-carotene delivery☆
pmc-12546682.creator: Yulian Zhu, Ziqi Wei, Qian Shi, Qin Dan, Mengqing Li, Xiuzhu Yu, Shuang-kui Du
pmc-12546682.description: This study revealed how the morphology of millet bran nanocelluloses, including cellulose nanocrystals (MCNCs), cellulose nanofibrils (MCNFs), and cellulose nanospheres (MCNSs), regulated the complexation with zein nanoparticles (ZNPs), thereby influencing structure and emulsifying performance of the resulting complexes. Electrostatic attraction, hydrogen bonding, and hydrophobic interaction induced ‘chain-bead-like’ structures in MCNCs-ZNPs and MCNFs-ZNPs, while MCNSs-ZNPs exhibited a ‘bead-bead-like’ structure.

pmc-12573211.title: Efficacy of Wee1 G2 Checkpoint Kinase and Mouse Double Minute 2 Homolog Inhibitors in Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors Determined by p53 Status
pmc-12573211.creator: Chiao-Ping Chen, Yan-Jei Tang, You-Yan Cai, Yi-Ru Pan, Chun-Nan Yeh, Wen-Kuan Huang, Chih-Hong Lo, Yu-Tien Hsiao, Hsuan-Jen Shih, Chiao-En Wu
pmc-12573211.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundKIT proto-oncogene, receptor tyrosine kinase (KIT, CD117) and platelet-derived growth factor-alpha (PDGFRA) are key drivers of gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST), but resistance to targeted therapy often arises from tumor protein p53 (p53) alterations and loss of cell cycle control.

pmc-13112435.title: Influence of HIV Status on Organ Procurement and Allocation: A Discrete Choice Experiment of Australian Transplant Providers
pmc-13112435.creator: David W J Griffin, Warittha Tieosapjaroen, Karl Vaz, Gopal Basu, William R Mulley, Sakhee Kotecha, Kovi Levin, Angeline Leet, Greg Snell, James H McMahon, Jennifer F Hoy, Jason J Ong
pmc-13112435.description: BackgroundPeople with HIV (PWH) experience disparate access to solid organ transplantation (SOT) but are eligible to be organ recipients and donors in Australia. Clinician decision-making about the allocation and utilization of organs is central to transplant access. This study aimed to determine the influence of HIV infection, and other key attributes, in decision-making about SOT recipients and donors.

pmc-13383938.title: From trial to clinic: psilocybin’s efficacy in routine treatment-resistant depression
pmc-13383938.creator: Vassilis Martiadis
pmc-13383938.description: e first responses from routine clinical practice.1 Among 19 adults with treatment-resistant depression (TRD) who were treated with psilocybin under Switzerland’s limited medical use framework, clinician-rated symptoms decreased substantially (a Montgomery–Åsberg reduction of approximately 11 points; Hedges’ g ≈ 1.4).

pmc-13619945.title: Probable everolimus-associated severe colitis with hematochezia in a patient with metastatic hormone receptor–positive, HER2-negative breast cancer: a case report
pmc-13619945.creator: Ahmad Fatayer, Salem K. Qupp, Joyce Morcos, ZainEdeen Zyadah, Alaa Alresheq, Jahed Bushnaq, Marwan Qubaja, Ola Abu Laban
pmc-13619945.description: BackgroundEverolimus, an inhibitor of the mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR), is used with endocrine therapy for endocrine-resistant hormone receptor–positive, human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2)–negative advanced breast cancer. Although diarrhea is a recognized adverse effect, severe inflammatory colitis accompanied by gastrointestinal bleeding is rare and remains insufficiently characterized.

pmc-13624695.title: CD73‐Overexpressing ADSCs Promote Neurogenic Bladder Repair via A2A–JAK1/STAT3‐Mediated Modulation of Inflammation and Macrophage Polarization
pmc-13624695.creator: Guanqun Zhu, Guoyi Jiang, Jiao Huang, Yuxuan He, Zongliang Zhang, Rui Zhang, Xinbao Yin, Kai Zhao, Xiaokun Yang, Woong Jin Bae, Ke Wang, Yuelin Zhang

pmc-13711946.title: Heavy metals exposure and infertility: a systematic review and meta-analysis of observational studies
pmc-13711946.creator: Saba Goodarzi, Motahareh Hasani, Shirin Djalalinia, Razieh Lotfi, Armita Mahdavi-Gorabi, Mostafa Qorbani
pmc-13711946.description: BackgroundInfertility is a major public health concern worldwide, with growing evidence implicating environmental exposures to heavy metals as potential contributors. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the association between heavy metals in biological samples and infertility among men and women.MethodsFollowing PRISMA guidelines, a systematic search on PubMed, Scopus, and Web of Science was conducted.

uslaw-usc-t20-s4073.title: 20 U.S.C. § 4073 — Severability
uslaw-usc-t20-s4073.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t20-s4073.description: United States Code, Title 20 (Education); Chapter 52 (Education For Economic Security); Subchapter VIII (Equal Access). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. If any provision of this subchapter or the application thereof to any person or circumstances is judicially determined to be invalid, the provisions of the remainder of the subchapter and the application to other persons or circumstances shall not be affected.
